lineItems.details: Delivery and professional install of Engineered Wood Fiber (EWF) playground mulch at a 3" depth.
Delivery and professional install of washed pea gravel for a bright, decorative finish.
Delivery and professional install of crushed granite stone for a firm, long-term, low-maintenance surface. Higher cost per ton, but superior performance.

notes:
1. Scope of Work:
Professional restoration of an existing 375 sqft play area, including removal of all organic turf, installation of weed-suppression membrane, and placement of high-quality surface material. Existing edging will be utilized and secured to contain the new material. Removal & Disposal of old turf, dirt, pine needles, etc is included. 

2. Why This Work is Necessary:
The current grass surface is not preferred and prone to weeds. Removal of the sod layer is essential to create a “clean slate.” By installing a professional-grade geotextile fabric, we lock out competitive weeds and provide a stable base, ensuring the surface material stays tidy and level long-term.

3. Execution Plan:
- Excavation: Mechanical removal of existing sod to a 2–3 inch depth to ensure the new material sits flush with your current edging.
- Leveling & Compaction: The base will be leveled and tamped to prevent uneven settling or “bowling” during heavy rain.
- Professional Membrane: Installation of heavy-duty, non-woven geotextile fabric. This is a critical step; it separates the soil from the material and prevents weeds from migrating upward.
- Containment: The existing edging will be inspected and re-anchored as necessary to ensure a clean perimeter.
- Material Install: Even distribution and grading of your chosen surface material to a consistent 3-inch depth across the entire area.
